chapters.title: Azure DevOps as LLMOps control plane
Why hybrid wins and how to decide

takeaways: In regulated enterprises Azure DevOps remains the governance backbone because boards, pipelines, test plans and approvals form an end-to-end audit trail that is costly to rebuild elsewhere.
AI regulation such as the EU AI Act demands continuous evidence across data, evaluation, approval and monitoring, which makes gated Azure DevOps pipelines a natural LLMOps control plane.

A selective hybrid model, with GitHub for code and AI-assisted development and Azure DevOps for formal governance, avoids the cost trap of a full migration but needs a platform team, integration patterns and shared metrics.
hook: Everyone says Azure DevOps is legacy and GitHub is the future, yet regulated enterprises keep running ADO. This episode is for CIOs, platform and DevOps leaders who must deliver AI under growing compliance pressure, and it shows why a deliberate GitHub plus Azure DevOps hybrid, with clear workload allocation and governance, beats a costly all-in migration.
